aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable before/after repair evidence but misgroups the changed factor and includes unsupported measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor mixes baseline/test with machine and base-side subgroup keys.
Primary comparison should be before repair vs after repair, under VP/CD separate repair context.
M/C and Base left/right must remain subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Measurement outcomes are header-derived aggregates, not true measurement results.
Outcome coverage omits available right-side and M/C2 before/after context handling.
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to repair/separation condition: before repair vs after repair.
Use line, date, machine, and base side as subgroup keys.
Keep vision VP/CD and checking-function outcomes under the same repair context.
Remove header-only measurement outcomes or recast as defect-category counts with data rows.
Rebuild comparisons using matched machine/base-side rows and note unmatched M/C2 after-repair absence if applicable.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and are sufficient for rework, but current grouping citations are not sufficient for final evidence.
